writing1.title: Writing 1 · Historical museum attendance data
writing1.prompt: The chart shows how many students visited the school heritage exhibition during four weeks. Describe the changes in attendance from 32 to 48 to 59 to 73 students. Compare the weeks and summarise the overall trend in at least 100 words.

chart.title: Visitors to the school heritage exhibition

teacherKeyFacts: Attendance rises in each successive week.
The first week has 32 visitors and the last has 73.
Largest weekly increase is 16, between Weeks 1 and 2.
writing1.grading: teacher rubric required; no automatic writing grade

writing2.title: Writing 2 · Formal heritage exhibition email
writing2.prompt: Your school is planning an exhibition called Everyday History. Write a formal email of at least 100 words to the local museum coordinator. Explain the purpose of the exhibition, ask whether the museum could lend safe replicas or provide advice, describe how students will check historical sources, and politely request a reply.
writing2.grading: teacher rubric required; no automatic writing grade
